scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Welcome to Alberta,
the Port City. Feel free
to ask me if you're having
trouble finding anything in
town, or if you just need
guidance around the city.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔贝塔向导]
欢迎来到港口城市艾尔贝塔。
如果您在城镇中找不到任何地方，
或者只是需要一些指引，
请随时向我提问。

scripts.text: City Guide
scripts.translation: 城市向导

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔贝塔向导]
如果您不想在小地图上
显示位置标记，
请告诉我“移除小地图标记”。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔贝塔向导]
魔法与科技的进步
让我们得以更新资讯系统，
现在最多可以在小地图上标记
多个位置，方便您导航。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔贝塔向导]
小地图位于屏幕的右上角。
如果您看不到它，
请按下Ctrl + Tab键，
或点击基础资讯窗口中的“地图”按钮。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔贝塔向导]
在小地图上，
点击“+”和“-”符号
可以放大或缩小地图。
祝您在艾尔贝塔城旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Be safe when you
travel and don't hesitate
to ask me if you have any
questions about Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔贝塔向导]
旅行时请注意安全，
如果对艾尔贝塔有任何疑问，
请随时向我提问。
